text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty P0 - elevated 5xx and timeouts observed from inference-gateway -> edge-lb. Spike started ~03:12 UTC. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/5xx-spike | Top symptoms: upstream 503/504, Envoy circuit_breaker open events, retries_count jumped. Possible recent route/retry change around 03:11 from CI. Paging oncall.

oncall_mike: Ack, I'm on. Which services are showing the biggest hit? Any customer-facing impact yet?

sara_eng: Seeing it in inference-gateway and edge-lb metrics. Retries_count correlates with error spike (retries -> more load -> more 5xx). I pulled config commits: deploy-bot rolled route-change 03:10 that modified per-route retry_policy and reduced circuit breaker thresholds for a perceived latency issue. Diff snippet:

```yaml
route:
  retry_policy:
    num_retries: 5
    per_try_timeout: 2s
  circuit_breakers:
    thresholds:
      - max_connections: 100
        max_pending_requests: 50
```

sara_eng: That combination can amplify failures if upstream has transient errors — retries multiply load and CB trips quickly.

raj_sre: Confirmed from logs: repeated upstream 5xx followed by Envoy upstream_reset and overflow logs. This looks like retry amplification + low CB capacity. Immediate mitigation options: 1) disable retries at gateway (num_retries: 0) 2) raise circuit breaker thresholds temporarily 3) route traffic to healthy pool if available. Recommend (1)+(2) immediately.

devops-jen: I can hotpatch the gateway route. Plan: set `num_retries: 0` and increase `max_pending_requests` to 200. Applying now via k8s configmap patch.

devops-jen: Command I'll run:
```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap gateway-routes --type merge -p '{"data": {"edge-route.yaml": "route:\n  retry_policy:\n    num_retries: 0\n  circuit_breakers:\n    thresholds:\n      - max_connections: 1000\n        max_pending_requests: 200"}}'
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: starting configmap patch on gateway (job id: cfgpatch-1735). Rolling update triggered.

oncall_mike: Noted. Who will watch metrics and customer impact while this rolls?

emily_cs: CS: We're already seeing a 15% error rate for ACME corp on their inference endpoint. I've opened a high-priority ticket with them and sent a status note. Will update customers once we have a mitigation outcome.

devops-jen: Patch applied. Rolling restart of gateway pods to pick up new config.

incident-bot: :eyes: automated alert: gateway 5xx rate decreased from 22% -> 6% within 90s after patch. Latency stable. Continuing to monitor.

raj_sre: Looks much better. Circuit_breaker open events dropped and upstream 503 logs reduced. This confirms retry amplification was primary amplifier.

sara_eng: Can we confirm there are no regressions from disabling retries? Any services relying on retries for flakiness masking?

devops-jen: Quick smoke: core inference calls succeeded against canary backends. No increased latency for normal traffic. I recommend keeping retries off at gateway and instead rely on per-backend retry logic if needed.

oncall_mike: Handing off to raj_sre for the next 2h for oversight and post-incident followup. I'm stepping out. :wave:

raj_sre: Taking over. I'll keep the thread updated. Immediate action items captured:
- Mitigation applied: gateway retries disabled, CB thresholds increased temporarily.
- Customer impact: ACME saw 15% error window; CS notified and tracking.
- Owners for postmortem: sara_eng (root cause and config review), devops-jen (hotpatch timeline), raj_sre (postmortem lead), emily_cs (customer comms).

sara_eng: Preliminary root cause: CI deployment inadvertently lowered circuit breaker capacity and increased retries to 5 to mask latency briefly — caused feedback loop under transient backend errors. Proposed long-term fixes:
- Add CI guardrail preventing simultaneous aggressive retry + low-CB changes
- Canary and automated rollback for route changes that touch retry/cb fields
- Alert for retry amplification pattern (retries_count rising before 5xx increase)

emily_cs: Noting customer comms: will send ACME a post-mitigation update and offer extended logs. They've paused production injests until 10:00 UTC.

raj_sre: We'll keep the gateway config with retries disabled and elevated CB thresholds for 30 minutes while we validate. After 30m stable, we'll roll a careful config that sets conservative retries (1) + higher CB thresholds + rollout to canary only.

oncall_mike: Thanks team, good quick mitigation. Please post a short incident summary and assign the postmortem. I'll check back later if needed. :thumbsup:

devops-jen: Noted. I'll create a follow-up PR with the controlled retry policy and canary rollout steps.

incident-bot: Incident P0 resolved -> mitigation applied. Tags: #oncall #sre #devops #customer-impact. Closing page in 45m if stable.

raj_sre: Adding final note: root-cause label = "retry-amplification + CB misconfiguration"; next steps: postmortem, CI guardrails, alert tuning. Closing handoff to SRE rotation.
